name: Winged Nightmare
_source: Monster Sheet, AI/BP/Trait cards, Signature, Routine — owner scans (readings owner-confirmed 2026-11-15); Clash Setup: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.38

footprint.rear: the single cell directly behind (R on the sheet diagram)

basicAbilities.name: Superior Bypass
basicAbilities.rule: Moves through Terrain and miniatures (lost while Slithering Tails is revealed).

traits.name: Regional Lair
traits.text: The Winged Nightmare’s Lair changes depending on the Kingdom. See your Kingdom Book for Setup instructions.

traits.name: Unpredictable Nature
traits.text:
The Winged Nightmare has 1 two-sided BP card. It starts the Clash with the Wide Wings side up. This BP remains in the same place during the Clash, regardless of Wounding or Failing. You cannot flip it using abilities. When you deal a Wound, place a Generic Single Wound card on the Wound Stack instead.

AI Response: Immediately resolve the “AI Response” effect of the top card of the AI discard pile. Triggers during Knight Attacks.
If, at any point, the AI discard pile is empty, discard the top AI card.
Escalate only the AI deck and always do so based on the AI Level of the top card of the AI discard pile.

traits.name: Fight and Flight
traits.text:
Flank: The Winged Nightmare moves to an empty space furthest from the center of the Clash Board that is adjacent to the Target or Attacker, prioritizing spaces in a straight line from a Chasm Terrain tile.

Flee X: The Winged Nightmare moves X spaces toward the closest Board Edge. If it already is or becomes adjacent to it, continue the movement along the Board Edge toward the next closest Board Edge.

When you resolve an AI Response, if the Attacker is at the Winged Nightmare’s Rear, ignore Flank and Flee X.

traits.name: Marble Forest
traits.text: As a free action, or instead of a Reflex, Knights may climb adjacent Column Terrain tiles. When a Knight is about to suffer Knockdown or involuntary movement while on a Column Terrain tile, they are Displaced and suffer Crash instead.

traits.name: Tougher than She Looks
traits.text: Endure X: The Winged Nightmare gains X temporary positive AT [AT] tokens.

traits.name: Siren’s Spite
traits.text: If the Winged Nightmare moves off a Column Terrain tile, that tile is destroyed.

traits.name: Bloody Defiance
traits.text:
The Winged Nightmare cannot die from Wounds. When you deal the final Wound, immediately place the Bloody Defiance BP Trait card on top of the BP card and resolve its Response instead. Until the end of the Clash, Knights attack this BP Trait card instead.

Ignore this Trait during Exhibition Clashes.

traits.name: Nixie’s Fury
traits.text:
During the Knight Round, when the second Knight ends their turn, draw and perform an AI card.

! For the purpose of this Trait treat dead Knights as empty turns. In other words, a dead Knight still counts as a Knight for the 2 Knight turn limit.

traits.name: Coiling Malice
traits.text: When the Winged Nightmare moves through a Knight, that Knight suffers Crash.

clashSetup._source: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.38 (Winged Nightmare Clash — Sunken Kingdom diagram)
steps: Monster Positioning: Place the Winged Nightmare miniature on the space designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrow.
Additional Setup: Place the Wide Wings BP card on space 1 on the Mob track. Level 2+: Place the Bloody Defiance BP Trait card next to the Monster Sheet.

rulings: Single-Mob Clash: one 1x1 Mob with the two-sided BP on Mob-track space 1; one AI Activation token (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Endure X: temporary +X AT until the next Power Roll (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Flank priority "straight line from a Chasm": spaces where Nightmare–Knight–Chasm are aligned (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

AI Response: on Fail (Wide Wings) / Instinct (Slithering Tails) / Wound (Bloody Defiance) resolve the AI Response of the top AI discard; Attacker on the Rear → only Flank / Flee are ignored (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Column tiles: the Nightmare perches on the tile; Knights climb onto it (Marble Forest) and leave by normal movement (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Drag X / Drag toward: rulebook keyword box (소유자 스캔 2026-11-15). Monster "Drag X toward the closest Chasm": the Nightmare moves toward and one space past the Chasm (max X), the Knight follows the path — entering the Chasm kills
Flee X ending on a Knight: Crash, then the Knight is Displaced — the Sheet prints no Unavoidable Knockback value for this Mob [해석, 확인 필요]

Knight Pushback X / Drag X against the Nightmare (Overpower, Slithering Tails, Bloody Defiance): chosen and resolved immediately; Pushback moves it X spaces directly away (stops at Obstacles / Knights / board edge); with Bloody Defiance out, entering a Chasm this way kills it [해석, 확인 필요]
Bloody Defiance: the final Wound is placed, then the BP Trait card replaces the BP and ITS Wound (or Critical → dies) response resolves instead [해석, 확인 필요]
"moves to the closest empty Column tile" while already on a Column: moves to another one [해석, 확인 필요]

"MOVE TO THE CLOSEST CHASM & JUDGE" (Aria of Doom): moves onto the closest Chasm space, then judges the Knights in Zone 4 of the new position; Misleading Melody / Aria movement is per hit (1 / 2 spaces per hit), Knights stop adjacent to the Chasm (voluntary movement cannot enter it) [해석, 확인 필요]
